11. Is envy a vice, or does it act as the fuel that drives society?

12. Is there an "expiration date" for a sin or crime, i.e. a set number of years of good behavior until we've forgiven and/or forgotten?

13. Is sorrow knowledge - as in, does it create "the burden of consciousness?"

14. Is humility a virtue, or — as Spinoza suggested — was it chosen as a method of keeping the people in submission?

15.Should you mix friends and business?

16. Do we truly love truth like we say we do, or do we secretly hate it when it challenges us?

17. Does true altruism exist, or is every “selfless” act secretly driven by self-interest?

18. Is ignorance bliss because it shields us from painful realities, or is a painful truth always better than a comfortable delusion?

19. Can second-chance love relationships ever work or are they doomed to fail?

20. Is the great man the master of history, or merely its slave?
